constraints: Update one major at a time. ng update accepts only a supported target major, and v20 is the only one-major target from v19.
v20 is LTS until 2026-11-28. After that date the one-major step from v19 is no longer supported by the release policy, so follow the Angular Update Guide for the path.

steps.instructions: Run `ng update @angular/core@20 @angular/cli@20` before 2026-11-28, then apply the v20 steps in the Angular Update Guide.
steps.title: Update to Angular v20

steps.instructions: After the v20 build and tests pass, run `ng update @angular/core@21 @angular/cli@21` and apply the v21 steps in the Angular Update Guide.
steps.title: Update to Angular v21

steps.instructions: After the v21 build and tests pass, run `ng update @angular/core@22 @angular/cli@22` and apply the v22 steps in the Angular Update Guide.
steps.title: Update to Angular v22

verification.purpose: Confirm that @angular/core resolves to the target major.
Build the application on the target major.
Run the unit tests when the project defines them.

rule.summary: Angular's release schedule states that Angular versions v2 to v19 are no longer supported. v19 receives no fixes, including security fixes.
rule.title: @angular/core v19 is no longer supported
